note:
22706 -> 22700, AND THE FLOOR IT REPLACES WAS NOT RE-DERIVABLE.

f4031cf8d2f set 23130 -> 22706, but a detached worktree at that commit measures
23138. The floor was banked against a tree that was never committed, so no
commit in this history reproduces 22706 and the note stored with it described a
different move (22723 -> 22706) than the count it carried. A floor nobody can
re-measure is not a floor: the next session cannot tell a regression from the
gap, which is how the gate came to sit red at -6 with nobody able to say what
the 6 were.

This one is measured in a detached worktree at HEAD, `npx eslint . -f json` over
the whole repo, and the delta from f4031cf8d2f's own tree is accounted for
entirely -- diffed by rule:

  prettier/prettier            21801 -> 21371   -430
  simple-import-sort/imports     377 ->   369     -8
  every other rule                          unchanged
                                                -----
                                                 -438

`no-undef` 597, `no-unused-vars` 139, `eqeqeq` 84, `no-var` 32 and the rest did
not move by one. So the whole of the fall is formatting debt paid down by
739628e5da5 and 5bf38d55818's comment strips and the commits after them, not a
behavioural rule going quiet -- which is the reading a bare count invites and
the reason the split is recorded here.

`addons/web` contributes ZERO of the 22700 and has for the whole window; the
count is almost entirely other addons' `static/src`.
